existence_and_uniqueness.fold_uniqueness: C4 uniquely determines y. On C4=0, K4'=4*h4^2*(U^-3-lambda*D^-3)>0 because lambda>1 and y>x; h4=cos(x) decreases. Thus the fold root is unique.
existence_and_uniqueness.equal_area_uniqueness: C3 uniquely determines v. The exact enclosure K3<0 gives dA3/dh3=K3/h3^3<0, while h3 decreases with w. Thus A3 increases strictly with w and the selected equal-area root is unique.
